categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Aladdin Biochemical Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research reagent manufacturing sector, covering four main fields: high-end chemistry, life sciences, analytical chromatography, and materials science. The company also provides a small range of laboratory consumables. It markets its products mainly under the 'Aladdin' brand for research reagents and 'Xinsi Valley' brand for laboratory consumables, primarily through its proprietary e-commerce platform.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies including formulation, separation and purification processes, efficient synthesis techniques, standard substance development, modification technologies, analytical methods, packaging, and filling processes. These technologies cover the entire lifecycle from R&D to final product formation, with many proprietary patents and non-patented technologies. The company emphasizes continuous R&D in catalyst preparation, molecular inhibitors, system analysis methods, molecular chemical libraries, high-purity compound preparation, and recombinant protein development, among others.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are scientific researchers and frontline R&D engineers in universities, research institutes, and enterprises in biomedicine, new materials, new energy, energy conservation and environmental protection, aerospace, and other high-tech and strategic emerging industries. The products serve diverse research needs in genomics, proteomics, metabolomics, immunology, cell biology, and analytical testing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Shanghai and subsidiaries in Singapore, the United States, Ireland, and Germany to support overseas markets. Its domestic sales cover major regions including East China, South China, North China, Central China, Northwest, Southwest, and Northeast China. Overseas subsidiaries focus on reagent R&D and sales targeting international customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Aladdin Biochemical Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the R&D, production, and sales of research reagents and laboratory consumables. It also engages in some upstream activities such as custom procurement and processing of certain raw materials to extend production capacity and control costs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on expanding its product lines in high-end chemistry, life sciences, analytical chromatography, and materials science, with a strong emphasis on import substitution. It invests heavily in R&D, with projects targeting catalyst preparation, formulation optimization, molecular inhibitors, system analysis methods, chemical libraries, high-purity compound preparation, recombinant proteins, and antibody development. The company aims to enhance its technological leadership, product quality, and e-commerce capabilities to consolidate its industry position.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of research reagents and laboratory consumables via its proprietary e-commerce platform and third-party platforms such as Tmall and JD.com. The sales model is characterized by frequent, small-batch purchases from a dispersed customer base. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a market historically dominated by foreign giants like Sigma-Aldrich and Thermo Fisher Scientific. Shanghai Aladdin is recognized as one of the domestic manufacturers with the most comprehensive product lines and has achieved significant import substitution in certain product categories. It holds a strong reputation domestically, with multiple industry awards and memberships, positioning itself as a leading Chinese brand in research reagents.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately RMB 533.56 million, a 32.44% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 98.76 million, up 15.07%. Total assets reached RMB 1.78 billion, growing 18.12% from the previous year. The company’s R&D investment accounted for 11.78% of revenue. It has steadily expanded through acquisitions, including a 51% stake in Shanghai Yuanye Biotech, contributing significantly to revenue and profit growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Aladdin emphasizes its commitment to import substitution, providing high-quality, domestically produced research reagents that meet or exceed international standards. Its competitive advantages include comprehensive product lines, advanced proprietary technologies, a robust quality control system with over 9,000 product standards, a trusted brand with strong customer loyalty, and an efficient e-commerce sales platform. The company also offers tailored solutions and rapid service response, catering to the diverse and evolving needs of scientific research institutions and high-tech industries.
